scene: The glowing key unlocks an atrium transit hub with three waiting departures.
picture: A flat side view of the bright hotel transit lobby. On the far left, a neon escalator ascends toward the roof. Left of centre, the player stands holding the glowing key. In the centre, a yellow noodle-cart monorail idles at a low gate. On the far right hangs a woven bamboo cable car.
